evidence.claim: The current v0.49 baseline defines bounded complete sync reads, conservative notification handling and authorized scoped recovery while preserving strict proof semantics.
CLI resolves shorthand inputs, emits early IDs/progress and bounded-wait outcomes, while preserving one JSON envelope and the original request identity.
Authenticated loopback service exposes request progress and preserves accepted work, single-writer admission and browser session boundaries.

Runtime routes model maintain to model/view inspection and versioned current-agent guidance, shares guidance with init and adds pending review hints to sync status without changing strict verification.
Workspace registry locates nearest directory/Git boundaries, keeps stable UUIDs across atomic Git adoption and rejects identity or path conflicts without Git downgrade.
Model validation checks evidence-list syntax before resolving IDs and gives declared-relationship DSL guidance while preserving identity and reference constraints.
TaskService preserves skill-hub/2 routing and archive boundaries, and directs authorized scoped sync recovery rather than stopping at an unexplained race.
Actual skill files and references are scanned, versioned and captured as editable file content.
Archive validates journal streams and references, retains compact metadata, rereads recorded bodies by byte position and recovers original receipts.
SearchIndex sends typed operations to a separate SQLite worker and supports derived projection rebuilding.
Git and filesystem adapters share byte/link capture; directory scans use hierarchical ignore rules and two enumerations plus byte checks, preserving unknown on failures.

Freshness filters definite Git bookkeeping notifications, bounds complete read recaptures, retains pending under ongoing changes and returns actionable recovery while preserving strict proof CAS, byte rollback and evidence boundaries.
ObservationManager restores explicit log bindings and checkpoint/events from the file archive.
Ordinary legacy discovery uses the owning verified archive and ordered commit metadata; explicit migration/requested legacy bytes and conservative GC retain existing checks and protected content.
Web labels actual directory workspaces and retains task, canvas, skill, structure and historical interactions.

Web confirms browser cookies before clearing successful sign-in credentials, retains the original URL on transient failures, clears explicitly rejected credentials with targets preserved, and keeps actual HTTP 401 reasons.
The runtime entry routes context and skills and points sync races to authorized recovery rather than unexplained task termination; real setup, history and authorization boundaries remain.
The bundled library has seven categories and 26 self-contained editable methods, with current upstream provenance, retired IDs and explicit user-library preservation.
Candidate package 0.1.2 retains the Node 24 and dependency contracts; this patch adds sync recovery without changing dependency scope.
Frozen v0.16 prototype and MGRP examples remain historical/reference material separate from the formal implementation.
Model/context contract retains current-agent text maintenance and historical bindings; v0.48 records the 26-method adaptation and dynamic routing without transitive skill selection.

Controller distinguishes live startup ownership from stopped/authenticated endpoints, joins bounded startup without spawning a competitor, sanitizes optional build metadata and preserves pre-execution-only RPC retries. Permission failures reading the service descriptor or startup lock remain native IO failures, and spawn errors retain available system diagnostics.
Web documentation describes visible-history restoration beyond the first page, error fallback and non-current model snapshot labels.
Layout counts every node of each omitted subtree with a temporary stack, keeps visible hit paths and synthetic body leaves out of overflow counts, and preserves bounded disclosure and input trees.
Skill layout preserves saved selection identities and groups, aggregates unselected catalog members and folders, and omits unselected file nodes.
Standalone context and skill directories provide scoped search, hit filtering and 50-row paging with explicit inspection and candidate actions.
Batch read-only Git classification distinguishes tracked, untracked, ignored and unknown local document evidence without staging or changing source exclusions.
The v0.49 sync contract distinguishes definite Git bookkeeping from source-affecting or unknown events, bounds complete status recapture and retains strict proof and rollback checks.

Storage preserves original journals and snapshots; new freshness rows reference receipt state bytes, and compact derived indexes catch up continuous commits. Reviewed for v0.44 directory workspace support and retained compatibility boundaries.
Default methods link only to their own archived attachments; user related candidates remain optional and historical bytes remain immutable.
Runtime reference orders sync readiness, structured conflict inspection, actual scoped review, a fresh declaration/request ID and honest pending reporting.
Static help exposes installed schemas, stable-read readiness and structured sync recovery without starting the service or authorizing proof rebasing.
A conservative display-only predicate marks suspected damaged reasons without changing archived input.
Skill details show a suspected encoding warning and expose the exact saved reason on demand.
Isolated browser checks exercise Unicode, damaged and operator reasons, self-contained review bytes, and unchanged saved plans/batches.

Installer regression covers canonical attachment paths, linked skill roots, byte-preserving backups and direct execution through a package directory alias with JSON, reinstallation and invalid-argument checks.
Isolated regressions cover Git bookkeeping false positives, bounded read convergence and ongoing writes, real Git metadata invalidation, rollback, scoped evidence and immutable recovery receipts.
Implementation status distinguishes the v0.49 sync recovery candidate and actually completed verification from prior platform and host results.

The explicit runtime-skill installer uses Node main-module identity so aliased entry paths execute its JSON CLI; imports do not perform installation. Existing backup and destination-link checks remain. Permission refusal adds errno/path/operation and recovery hints while retaining partial copy results.
The actual npm consumer smoke checks candidate 0.1.2, native runtime/service identity, immutable historical handoff and existing browser gates.
Isolated HTTP/CLI regressions cover joining an existing startup owner, sanitized metadata and prior classified health, admission, endpoint rotation, death recovery and lost committed responses.
Retained prototype model watching reconciles content hashes after missed native notifications, skips unchanged parsing, and cancels reconciliation when closed.
Real-file prototype regressions retain the native watcher deadline and inject lost notifications to verify equal-length content edits update the parsed model and persisted valid revision.

Explicit installer verification checks package/runtime provenance, the actual resident build and RPC, optionally compares a saved handoff, and reports completed phases without automatically replaying failed business requests.
CLI build stamping records actual Git provenance or unknown, dependency-lock bytes and compiled runtime fingerprint without exposing machine paths or credentials.
Package helpers expose a restricted build projection and fingerprint packaged runtime files; missing provenance remains unknown.

The platform installation flows preserve an old package, verify the expected clean source and running build, and describe explicit saved-handoff checks and data-preserving rollback. Reviewed for v0.44 directory workspace support and retained compatibility boundaries. Restricted-host troubleshooting distinguishes command provisioning from CLI permission diagnostics and scopes approval to actual failed access.

English installation guidance distinguishes a missing CLI from project setup, reuses relevant authorization, uses the maintained INSTALL guide, and preserves old handoffs, package/skill backups, data roots and single-service recovery boundaries. Reviewed for v0.44 directory workspace support and retained compatibility boundaries. Installation consent does not grant OS/sandbox access; copy and service verification outcomes remain separate.
Isolated real-server tests block archive recovery while checking control readiness/RPC and GC exclusion, and count shared-content reads across startup and first worktree access.

A separate synthetic two-worktree benchmark seeds full TaskService histories and measures fresh-process control readiness, total first handoff, warm RPC and peak RSS while checking authoritative journal hashes.
Archive tests include low-heap streaming recovery, immutable references and corruption detection while preserving journal bytes.
The actual CLI reports a live unpublished startup owner as unavailable, rejects false stop success, and leaves the lock and owner intact.
Known-ID handoff returns the original packet without copying unrelated committed history; existing source/CAS, retention, historical and corrupt-archive checks remain.
TC07/08/22/27 cover notification classification, bounded reads, ongoing activity, strict stale-proof rejection and executable scoped recovery.

Architecture separates preflight/control availability from background recovery while retaining singleton ownership, full target verification, explicit subscriptions and safe shutdown. Reviewed for v0.44 directory workspace support and retained compatibility boundaries.
The CLI contract defines pending SOURCE_CHANGING status and additive structured SYNC_RACE recovery with immutable original receipts.
FR02/03/07/09/12/15 require real structure/view coverage review and current-agent progressive maintenance without fabricated graph quotas or automatic background modeling.
The current CLI specification includes v0.49 sync-notification handling and scoped recovery without relaxing proof CAS or history boundaries.

Current v0.49 agent obligations require bounded stable-state reads and re-review before a new declaration, with specific pending scope and next action under continued activity.
The existing synthetic fixture generator is reusable by the full-history benchmark; its prior small-record/core/CLI methodology remains separately scoped.
Client regressions check interrupted and malformed sign-in, delayed cookie confirmation, rejected credentials, missing cookies, cleaned URLs, exact targets and legacy HTTP 401 responses.
An isolated real HTTP service distinguishes missing, invalid/used and expired login codes with a test clock, while valid cookies, fixed expiry and origin rejection remain enforced.

The browser regression injects interrupted first and confirmation requests plus missing cookies, exercises button and same-document fresh-link recovery, and checks credential cleanup, exact target, unchanged session expiry and task archive.

Web restores recorded targets without source reconciliation, deduplicates covered events and counts complete hidden subtrees while preserving authentication and fixed history. Reviewed for v0.44 directory workspace support and retained compatibility boundaries.
Initialization and follow-up maintenance require actual responsibilities/dependencies and view coverage review, three current-agent modes, gradual implemented scope and continuing identity/history.
Installed usage explains unstable read readiness and authorized refresh/review/new-declaration recovery while keeping original receipts and real pending scope.
Isolated CLI checks require explicit ask-user and conditional fallback for initialization and registration, preserve worktree bytes before consent and reject unrelated target onboarding.
Isolated source regressions cover UTF-8 batch bounds, ordinary-byte/ignore mutations, ancestor-link replacement before and after delayed classification, and stdin failure without a process crash.
Child-process fault injection is confined to fixture files and observes Git calls, linked-descendant queries, source reads and pipe failure without adding production hooks.

An unrun isolated synthetic comparator measures cold/warm task entry and daemon lifetime resources, checks returned context/skill bytes and restart handoff, and retains fixture/build provenance; no final performance result is claimed.
